correctness.rationale: Backward Poisson gaps produce independent Laplace innovations at rate sqrt(lambda/D); bounded contraction gives an absolutely convergent stationary series and geometric coupling uniqueness. Separating its first Laplace innovation and a strictly stronger exponential moment of the remainder rigorously yields the exact absolute-tail coefficient, including when marks vanish. A Tonelli nonnegative multiindex expansion orders the coefficient by even moments. Strict Jensen and R^(2k)<=rho^(2k-1)R give all inequalities and unique equality cases. The elementary q-binomial functional equation computes the upper product. A standalone Python checker passed 319 finite assertions, including numeric convolution tails; no infinite claim is inferred solely from finite runs.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The strongest covering results concern either a fixed deterministic factor or an unrestricted perpetuity tail transfer. Those cover components of the proof, but the final quantified optimization over all bounded iid random reset rules of specified mean is an additional mathematical statement; the available primary results do not exhibit a theorem with assumptions implying both extremizers and their sharp expressions. An abstract general convex-order theorem may supply this implication and is retained as a risk.

originality.rationale: Claim assessed for originality is the complete fixed-mean sharp random-multiplier tail-prefactor envelope, unique deterministic and endpoint-Bernoulli extremizers, and convex-order monotonicity. The deterministic prefactor and generic exponential perpetuity tail transfer are already implied by older literature and are explicitly not claimed as novel. Random-affine-reset moment formulas from 2026 and earlier random-amplitude resetting for ballistic systems do not imply the joint sharp optimization on the inspected material. Full historical priority, including an abstract convex-order reduction not found in searches, remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: The abstract convex-order comparison of multiplicative perpetuities might be available in a more general theorem and imply the entire bound without matching terminology.

value.rationale: The precise quantity T(R) controls rare stationary excursions of a well-motivated diffusive process at fixed Poisson rate and mean reset retention. Physically admissible bounded multiplier distributions form a natural design class, and the theorem finds both exact optimal laws, proves uniqueness and exposes strict amplification by added reset-factor variability. This provides a substantive new extremal principle beyond mean/variance formulas, without presuming a broad downstream theorem. The beta/Gamma or q-series algebra is not the motivation by itself; its role is an explicit value for a natural extremal rare-event observable.
